# B2 vocabulary batch 101

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `mistreat`, `mistrustful`, `misunderstand`, `mobility`,
`modernisation`, `modernise`, `modernization`, `modernize`, `mogul`, `mold`, `momentarily`,
`momentary`, `monastery`, `moody`, `moonscape`, `morality`, `morally`, `mortar`, `mortify`,
`mother-in-law`, `motorist`, `mould`, `mournful`, `moustache`, and `mover`.

The Vietnamese example for `moustache` was revised because the initial translation contained a word
that the checker correctly treats as a Vietnamese proper-name token. The final row was rechecked
manually and passes the editor checker.
